ex_farmers_walk.name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Pick up a dumbbell in each hand with the trunk braced.
Walk through a clear measured path with short steady steps and level shoulders, then set the weights down under control.

Optional frame carry: stand centered between a suitable rickshaw frame's handles, lift with the trunk braced, walk through a clear measured course and lower the frame under control at the finish. Track the frame type, handle height and load consistently; frame loads are not directly interchangeable with two dumbbells.

review.method: AI editorial application of the user-approved 186-row simplification; not independent trainer review.

cat_cond_suitcase_carry.name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Hold one dumbbell beside the body and stand tall.
Walk a clear measured path without leaning toward or away from the weight, then set it down and repeat the other side.
The entered distance applies to each side.
